spans.s: pil̤l̤aigal̤-tanam (SITI), Tamil; status of the prince, supposed to be an officers' cadre composed of the junior members of the royal family. Cf. Kumār-āmātya.
pīlu (IE 8-3), Indian form of Arabic-Persian fīl, an elephant.
Pīlupati (IE 8-2, 8-3; EI 13, 28; CII 4), leader of the elephant force or keeper of the elephants; cf. Mahāpīlupati, pīlu.
